scope: 主线、支线地图、约会/聊天剧情、档案/相册、日程和混合活动故事页面；包含窗口、弹窗、列表组件、共享 UI、章节封面、节点显隐、Animator 状态/剪辑/转移及可追溯贴图。

coverage.dependencyResolutionNote: Prefab objects are inventoried for the selected story UI set. External CAB references were searched across the package; shared atlas sprites are cropped from the highest-resolution matching atlas where available. Unresolved CAB and path IDs remain in each prefab record; Unity built-in mesh references remain engine-provided.
excludedContent: Per-scene dialoguecut CG sequences and dialoguebackground paintings are narrative media, not reusable UI. Only images directly referenced by covered prefabs, shared atlases, or story-list surfaces are imported.
Standalone non-story gameplay screens are outside this inventory.
